title: VoxExporter
body:
# VoxExporter
## Info
Export buildings from Minecraft to `.vox` file format.

## How to use
Execute the command 
```
/exportvox
```
with a name and two positions.

## Example
```
/exportvox test 0 0 0 10 10 10
```


Files will appear in the /vox folder inside the Minecraft root directory.
